{{Top|canon=Red ball jett organ}}
[[File:Red_ball_jett_organ.png|250px|thumb|Max Rebo playing his Red Ball Jett keyboard.]]
{{Quote|I do have this old organ that none of us use anymore though. It's yours if you can haul it out of here.|[[Blerx Tango]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BT">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Blerx Tango|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The '''Nalargon''' or '''Red Ball Jett keyboard''' was a keyboard instrument similar to an organ. Circular in shape, the [[Musician/Legends|player]]&mdash;known as a '''Nalargonist'''<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=location|Dealer's Den Cantina|Coruscant}}</ref>&mdash;would sit in the center of the instrument, depressing any combination of the 21 keys. Air intake was to the player's left, while the output speaker was on their right. Between the base of the organ and the keyboard were air outlet pipes.

[[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]] was known to play a Nalargon.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
